jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Quality Intelligence supports data and AI in Anduril's manufacturing quality organization through three distinct areas: Analytics, Manufacturing AI, and Vision Inspection. Analytics owns end-to-end data and analytics work that directly drives impact for Anduril's product quality engineers on the factory floor. Our customers are program quality leaders, manufacturing engineers, and operators across sites and programs. The work encompasses building scorecards that catch quality drift before customers do, pipelines that turn ERP / MES / QMS data into decisions, and AI tools that compress hours of manual triage into minutes. We operate hub-and-spoke. HQ builds platform-grade analytics centrally; site engineers localize and run them at each manufacturing site. This is the site analytics lead role at our Atlanta facility. You are the resident analytics engineer and the person accountable for what Quality Intelligence has deployed here. Atlanta already has production dashboards and pipelines running; you will own them, keep them accurate, and improve them as programs evolve. Beyond maintaining what exists, you will build new analytics products as the site takes on new programs and requirements from the floor. Most of this role is hands-on build; the rest is running the site as a program: gathering requirements from operators and engineers, sequencing the work, driving rollouts to completion, and feeding what you learn back into the HQ roadmap. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE JOB Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a world-class Demand & Supply Planner to join our team. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools. The right person for this role has demonstrate ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. jobs.location_raw: Costa Mesa, California, United States; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Discovery is Anduril's team for the hard concepts: the ones that are not yet proven or built. We take the newest and hardest problems across space, missiles, air, sensors, autonomy, and cyber, decide what is worth building, and prove it out: we build the models, break the assumptions, run the tests, and carry what works to the point where a program can pick it up. We work with hardware and software engineering teams across the company, driving cross-functional collaboration across different business lines. ABOUT THE JOB We are building an expeditionary force: a small group of engineers who want to do big, new, hard things and who move into unfamiliar territory as a matter of course. As Deputy Chief Engineer in Discovery, you lead the technical work on concepts nobody has proven, usually several at once. You learn whatever domain each one lives in and build the thing that tests it: the prototype, the test article, the demonstration. Analysis gets a concept to the point where it is worth building; building it is how we find out. You are the technical authority for the concepts you own: you set the approach, review the work, and decide, on the evidence, which concepts continue and which stop. The problems change; the approach does not: reason from first principles, build it, test it, and reach a solution. You are not hired for a particular skill set.
